description: From the Codex review of the commit that never silenced a runner shape and made a FAIL need a certain, immutable binding (a false FAIL on main): the test's assertion moves into a local helper that happens to be called `it`. A name of the test API is the runner's only through a static import: here `it` is the file's function, which may assert, so TG004 warns (assertions may live in it), never FAIL. The real runner passes, and would fail if the sum were wrong.
